deathBeat: d15: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ugly-Eyes is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d15: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Natalie Adeyemi is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d15: 🕯️ Natalie Adeyemi is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
recoverHome: d16: That night, they bring Natalie home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
vouch: d15: At the grave, Oliver speaks for Adrian — "Natalie trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
burialWindowSay: d15: At the grave, Oliver speaks for Adrian — "Natalie trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d15: ◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
d16: That night, they bring Natalie home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
d16: ◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
d18: You say a few words for Natalie. Not a ceremony — just: you were here, and someone noticed you leaving. (-3 trauma)
d18: You bury Natalie. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+4 trauma)
d18: Not guilty. The count falls short — you breathe. But an accusation leaves a mark no verdict washes off. Some faces at the fire say they'll remember anyway.
echoSample: d18: "Good question." "Natalie always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
d18: "I keep turning over the last thing Natalie said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
d22: "You want to know about that? Okay." "Natalie owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
d22: "The fire feels smaller without Natalie. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
d22: "I tend the fire without being asked for Natalie, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."
echoV2Sample: d18: The village raises a marker by the fire — Natalie, day 18. a stranger. A place to stand.
echoV2DeltaSample: d18: The village raises a marker by the fire — Natalie, day 18. a stranger. A place to stand.
halfRationLines: d76: "Triage tents and broth for the sick, or half rations till it passes, or the healthy hunt hard to keep everyone fed. Pick — everything costs."
